payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the current state-of-the-art models for speech recognition on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) dataset, including performance metrics and methodologies used.

claims.text: The current best model on WSJ is an HMM-based system that combines convolutional, recurrent, and fully connected layers, achieving the lowest WER.
An end-to-end system using lattice-free MMI on augmented data achieves competitive WER on WSJ, comparable to the best models.
A fully convolutional approach trained end-to-end on raw waveforms matches the current state-of-the-art performance on WSJ.
